🎬 Hacksaw Ridge (2016) — War Biography / Drama

Hacksaw Ridge (2016) tells the true story of Desmond Doss, a young American soldier who serves as a combat medic during World War II while refusing to carry a weapon because of his personal beliefs. Despite facing criticism and doubt from those around him, Doss remains determined to serve his country without compromising his principles.

When his unit is sent into the Battle of Okinawa, Doss finds himself surrounded by the realities of war. Instead of fighting with a weapon, he risks his own safety to rescue wounded soldiers and bring them to safety. His actions eventually challenge the way his fellow soldiers understand courage and bravery.

The film explores themes of faith, conviction, courage, sacrifice, and compassion. Doss demonstrates that bravery does not always mean confronting an enemy with force; sometimes it means standing firmly by your beliefs while putting yourself at risk to help others.

His journey also highlights the struggle of being different in a situation where everyone expects conformity. Despite being mocked and doubted, Doss refuses to abandon his convictions, proving that strength can come from compassion and determination rather than violence.

More than just a war movie, Hacksaw Ridge is a powerful story about standing by your principles, protecting others, and discovering that courage can take many different forms. ❤️‍🩹

💬 Do you think someone can be brave without ever picking up a weapon? Let us know in the comments! 👇

source_details.synopsis: Hacksaw Ridge is a 2016 epic biographical war film directed by Mel Gibson, and starring Andrew Garfield as Desmond Doss, an American combat medic in World War II who, as a Seventh-day Adventist, refused to use a weapon of any kind; Doss became the first conscientious objector to be awarded the Medal of Honor, for his service during the Battle of Okinawa. The film was written by Andrew Knight and Robert Schenkkan, based on the 2004 documentary The Conscientious Objector. The supporting cast includes Sam Worthington, Luke Bracey, Teresa Palmer, Hugo Weaving, Rachel Griffiths, and Vince Vaughn. Filming took place in Australia from September to December 2015.
